children.Now, let's listen and follow.How old are you?I'm three years old.I'm three.Nice work.Boys and girls, can you look and read by yourself?Nice reading, children.Now I guess Peter knows a lot you do?Let's share our photos and posters.Okay, Miss Fang.Look, Alice is going to share some photos with her classmates.Now, you are Alice.Can you say something about it?Now, let's listen and read what Alice says.I have a birthday party.My friends come to my party.We sing a birthday song, blow off the candles, cut the cake and eat the cake.I am so happy on my birthday.See, Alice is happy on her birthday.How about Peter?Wow, what a nice and happy party.Boys and girls, now you are Peter.What do you have?Can you tell me?Let's listen to Peter.What can he do at the party?You are Peter again.Now,
